description: In combination with `scen7-vl-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of a failure of air pollution mitigation. Same as `scen7-vl-SST`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) and aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions follow `scen7-h` instead of `scen7-vl`. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `scen7-vl-AQ`.
